class.name: PlayFabPartyChatControl
class.brief_description: Diagnostic wrapper around a PlayFab Party chat control.
class.description: Provides advanced access to a PlayFab Party chat control. Most title code should prefer the entity-key helpers on [PlayFabPartyChat] (such as [method PlayFabPartyChat.send_text_async] and [method PlayFabPartyChat.set_chat_permissions_async]) which do not require maintaining chat-control identity.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the chat control id.

method.name: get_user
method.description: Returns the [PlayFabUser] bound to the chat control, if local.

method.name: is_voice_enabled
method.description: Returns whether voice chat is enabled on the control.

method.name: is_text_enabled
method.description: Returns whether text chat is enabled on the control.

method.name: is_transcription_enabled
method.description: Returns whether transcription is enabled on the control.

method.name: is_local
method.description: Returns whether the chat control is local.

method.name: send_text_async
method.description: Sends [param message] to the listed target chat controls.

method.name: set_permissions_async
method.description: Updates the local chat-control relationship permissions for [param target]. See [enum PlayFabParty.ChatPermission].

method.name: set_audio_muted_async
method.description: Mutes or unmutes incoming [b]voice audio[/b] from [param target] on the local chat control. Independent of [method set_text_muted_async].

method.name: set_text_muted_async
method.description: Mutes or unmutes incoming [b]text chat[/b] from [param target] on the local chat control. Independent of [method set_audio_muted_async].

method.name: destroy_async
method.description: Destroys the chat control. The owning network may recreate it on demand.

method.name: get_local_chat_indicator
method.description: Returns the local capture indicator for this control. See [enum PlayFabParty.LocalChatIndicator]. Only meaningful when [method is_local] is [code]true[/code]; polled, not signalled.

method.name: get_chat_indicator
method.description: Returns the voice activity of this remote control as observed locally. See [enum PlayFabParty.ChatIndicator]. Polled, not signalled.

method.name: get_audio_input_state
method.description: Returns the last reported microphone state. See [enum PlayFabParty.AudioInputState].

method.name: get_audio_output_state
method.description: Returns the last reported playback device state. See [enum PlayFabParty.AudioOutputState].

method.name: get_audio_input_selection_type
method.description: Returns how the microphone was selected. See [enum PlayFabParty.AudioDeviceSelectionType].

method.name: get_audio_output_selection_type
method.description: Returns how the playback device was selected. See [enum PlayFabParty.AudioDeviceSelectionType].

method.name: get_audio_input_device_id
method.description: Returns the platform id of the bound microphone, or an empty string when the system default is in use.

method.name: get_audio_output_device_id
method.description: Returns the platform id of the bound playback device, or an empty string when the system default is in use.

method.name: is_audio_input_muted
method.description: Returns whether the local microphone is muted.

method.name: set_audio_input_muted_async
method.description: Mutes or unmutes the local microphone. This is the local player's own mute; [method set_audio_muted_async] mutes other players instead.

method.name: get_audio_render_volume
method.description: Returns the playback volume applied to [param target], in the range [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: set_audio_render_volume_async
method.description: Sets the playback volume for [param target]. [param volume] is clamped to the range [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_permissions
method.description: Returns the currently applied chat permissions toward [param target]. See [enum PlayFabParty.ChatPermission].

method.name: is_audio_muted
method.description: Returns whether incoming voice audio from [param target] is muted.

method.name: is_text_muted
method.description: Returns whether incoming text chat from [param target] is muted.

method.name: get_language
method.description: Returns the BCP-47 language code of the control.

method.name: set_language_async
method.description: Sets the BCP-47 language of the control.

method.name: get_transcription_options
method.description: Returns the active voice transcription bitmask. See [enum PlayFabParty.TranscriptionOptions].

method.name: set_transcription_options_async
method.description: Sets which chat controls get transcribed. See [enum PlayFabParty.TranscriptionOptions].

method.name: get_text_chat_options
method.description: Returns the active incoming text-chat bitmask. See [enum PlayFabParty.TextChatOptions].

method.name: set_text_chat_options_async
method.description: Sets receiver-side options applied to incoming text chat. See [enum PlayFabParty.TextChatOptions].

method.name: get_audio_encoder_bitrate
method.description: Returns the outgoing voice encoder bitrate in bits per second.

method.name: set_audio_encoder_bitrate_async
method.description: Sets the outgoing voice encoder bitrate in bits per second.

method.name: get_voice_audio_options
method.description: Returns the active voice audio processing bitmask. See [enum PlayFabParty.VoiceAudioOptions].

method.name: set_voice_audio_options_async
method.description: Sets voice audio processing options such as noise suppression. See [enum PlayFabParty.VoiceAudioOptions].

method.name: populate_text_to_speech_profiles_async
method.description: Asks PlayFab Party for the synthetic voices available to this control.

method.name: get_text_to_speech_profiles
method.description: Returns the [PlayFabPartyTextToSpeechProfile] snapshots cached by the last successful [method populate_text_to_speech_profiles_async].

method.name: get_text_to_speech_profile
method.description: Returns the profile selected for [param type]. See [enum PlayFabParty.SynthesizeTextToSpeechType].

method.name: set_text_to_speech_profile_async
method.description: Selects the synthetic voice used for [param type].

method.name: synthesize_text_to_speech_async
method.description: Synthesizes [param text] using the profile selected for [param type].

members.member: Local [PlayFabUser] bound to the chat control.
Whether the chat control is local.

signal.name: message_received
signal.description: Emitted when a text chat message is received on this control.

signal.name: transcription_received
signal.description: Emitted when a transcription is received on this control.
